title: Any Assets that has a blend of ground tiles to each other?

posts.author: ItsMeDevRoland
posts.body:

Tile/Tileset
Maker Format:
MZ
Makers I Own:
MV and MZ - //No clue why this is needed, but i respect the rules of the forum!
Art Style:
Anything? as long as its like the default tileset rpg maker mz has
Description:
I'll try to be brief, to save you all time!
(also i'm so so so sorry for my poor wording on the title... lets say i lack the proper words to tell my request)
but lately whilst i've been world building... i found that having a grass tile placed between sand tile is painful to look at, theres barely any blending and it looks a bit... awful... hence why i ask if any of you guys know any resources that has a blends of ground tilesets so i can easily transition grassy meadows and sand deserts
(i tried but... lets say my skills were as sharp as baton...)

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
I'm on mobile and can't check my collection for what you're looking for right now, but the reason we need to know what engines you own is so we know which resources you're allowed to use!
For example, if you were looking for a kitten sprite for MV, I would be inclined to recommend trying the default cat from XP--but if you don't own XP, you can't use that, so my suggestion would be useless!
